title: Bounded k-hop/shortest-path/blast-radius traversal API
description:
## G-10 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

Today's traversal surface is limited to one-hop reverse-reference lookup and a capped 32-node/120-edge static SVG visualization. Neither answers "what's the shortest path between these records" or "what's the blast radius if I change this node" — both explicitly called out as reviewer needs.

### Detailed Steps
1. Build on the Phase 2 typed-edge store (G-4/G-5) for correctness
2. Implement k-hop neighborhood (bounded depth + result cap), shortest-path (bounded max depth, fail fast beyond), and blast-radius (reverse k-hop) as API endpoints — mirroring bounded-tool-call discipline used elsewhere in the codebase
3. Surface in workbench UI as interactive graph (filterable by relation type/node kind/confidence, click-to-expand), replacing or supplementing current fixed 32/120-cap circular SVG

### Test Plan
- Shortest-path between two records with no connecting path returns "no path found within N hops"
- Blast-radius on highly-connected node respects result cap

Audit: `Data/Pages/audits/kb-graph-rag-audit-10-07-26-00-00-00.md` — G-10
